description: This file contains utility functions related to file operations such as reading properties from files, reading file contents, checking if a path is a regular file, recursive file searching, and property expansion within strings. It appears to be a helper header file for file and string utilities used within a larger C++ project.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)

methods.description: Initiates a recursive search for files starting from a given path with depth limits and exclusions.
